newsitem.title: USA: Exigent sees Q1 EPS at $0.08-$0.10/shr.
newsitem.headline: Exigent sees Q1 EPS at $0.08-$0.10/shr.

text.p: Holding company Exigent International Inc said Monday it foresaw earnings for the first quarter of between $285,000 and $360,000 or $0.08 a share and $0.10 a share.
Exigent, which owns Software Technology Inc, said sales for the quarter ended April 30 would likely reach about $7.9 million versus $7.1 million for the same period last year.
It reported a profit of $274,654 or $0.07 a share for the first quarter in 1996.
For the entire year, it reported a share loss of $0.13 against a profit of $0.29 for 1995.
Software Technology develops command and control systems for industry and government, primarily for satellite ground stations.
